question: Where does the gate's signing key live so that only the gate code can sign: (a) held by a separate unit or the sudo-relay that CC cannot read, with the gate asking it to sign; (b) in ~/.cairn with the signature also carrying the hash of the gate's own source, accepting that a process running as akien could forge; or (c) something else?
why_it_blocks: 'the right code wrote it' holds only if the signing key cannot be read by anything else running as akien, CC included; a key in ~/.cairn is readable by every process on the box
answer: Akien 2026-10-27: 'i think there's a block, at least we talked about a block, on you writing whatever file type the output certificate is. and was deemed enough. the point is: only a gate can write a certificate. how we get there is less important to me than that you bump your nose if you try. that's all.'
